name: Prayer of Healing
description:
Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points or recover 2 Stress Slots. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing and stress recovery increase by 1d8 and 1 slot, respectively, for each slot level above 2nd.
